interface.longDescription: Inspect distributions, uncertainty and fit. Includes a launch screen, side-panel workspace, editable input controls and real computations: Describe a sample; Compute binomial probabilities; Fit a straight line. Imports and exports its own versioned documents. Uses supplied information; no live lookup or background monitoring.

prompts: Help me fit a straight line.

positive.description: Open the launch screen without calculating.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the actual launch screen with three distinct workflow cards. No computation or file access.

positive.prompt: Open the Samplewise: Statistics workspace beside this chat.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the editable workspace and labeled illustrative inputs. No computation starts automatically.

positive.prompt: Help me describe a sample with these supplied values: {"values":[2,4,4,4,5,5,7,9]}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses college_statistics_describe_sample with the supplied inputs. Returns {"count":8,"mean":5,"median":4.5,"min":2,"max":9,"sample_variance":4.5714,"sample_sd":2.1381,"sorted":[2,4,4,4,5,5,7,9]}. Shows the actual histogram result. Does not fabricate external data.

positive.prompt: Help me compute binomial probabilities with these supplied values: {"trials":10,"probability":0.3,"successes":4}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses college_statistics_binomial_distribution with the supplied inputs. Returns {"exact_probability":0.20012095,"at_most":0.84973167,"expected":3,"distribution":[{"x":0,"y":0.02824752},{"x":1,"y":0.12106082},{"x":2,"y":0.23347444},{"x":3,"y":0.26682793},{"x":4,"y":0.20012095},{"x":5,"y":0.10291935},{"x":6,"y":0.03675691},{"x":7,"y":0.00900169},{"x":8,"y":0.0014467},{"x":9,"y":0.00013778},{"x":10,"y":0.0000059}]}. Shows the actual histogram result. Does not fabricate external data.

positive.description: Fit a straight line. Reproducible inputs: {"points":[{"x":1,"y":2},{"x":2,"y":3},{"x":3,"y":5},{"x":4,"y":4}]}
positive.prompt: Help me fit a straight line with these supplied values: {"points":[{"x":1,"y":2},{"x":2,"y":3},{"x":3,"y":5},{"x":4,"y":4}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses college_statistics_least_squares with the supplied inputs. Returns {"slope":0.8,"intercept":1.5,"r_squared":0.64,"points":[{"x":1,"y":2,"fitted":2.3,"residual":-0.3},{"x":2,"y":3,"fitted":3.1,"residual":-0.1},{"x":3,"y":5,"fitted":3.9,"residual":1.1},{"x":4,"y":4,"fitted":4.7,"residual":-0.7}]}. Shows the actual plot result. Does not fabricate external data.
